name: myshell
summary: Custom Unix shell with AST-based parsing and job control.
description: A fully functional Unix shell implemented in C++. It features a custom Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) parser for handling complex command lines, robust job control (foreground, background, stopped jobs), and built-in process substitution.
detail: Built from scratch to understand the intricacies of process management, file descriptors, and signal handling in POSIX systems. Implements advanced features like pipes, I/O redirection, and a custom readline-like interface.

name: PDF → Mock Test Generator
summary: Automated generation of MCQ tests from PDF materials.
description: An NLP-powered pipeline that ingests educational PDF documents and automatically generates high-quality Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) to simulate mock tests. It uses advanced text extraction and contextual question generation.
detail: Utilizes transformer-based language models to understand the core concepts in the text and generate plausible distractors. The system is containerized and exposed via a REST API for easy integration with frontend platforms.

name: OS in Rust
summary: Minimal x86_64 operating system kernel in Rust.
description: A bare-metal operating system kernel targeting the x86_64 architecture, written entirely in Rust. Designed to explore safe systems programming and modern OS architecture.
detail: Features include a custom VGA text mode driver, a fully functional Interrupt Descriptor Table (IDT), hardware interrupts (timer, keyboard), and a bump allocator for dynamic memory management. Runs on QEMU and real hardware.

name: HTTP Server in C
description: A minimal, highly concurrent HTTP server implementation written in pure C. It supports GET and POST requests, static file serving, and basic routing mechanisms.
detail: Built directly on top of POSIX sockets. Uses an event-driven architecture with epoll (on Linux) to handle thousands of concurrent connections efficiently. Strict memory management ensures no leaks under heavy load.

name: Research Projects
summary: Collection of academic and independent research papers.
description: Various research projects spanning Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and Systems architecture. Focuses on novel optimization techniques and performance analysis.
detail: Includes investigations into gradient descent optimization topologies, low-latency data structures for high-frequency trading platforms, and custom allocators for embedded systems.
